run: finding F1: the modulation engines' false-positive rate on configurations whose sites share a cell-level variable, before (the engines of c4d8d83) and after (6305217), over 1,000 fresh configurations of each of the validation's DEV generator kinds (validation/cases.js, both JS engines) and of each of tests/modulation_configs.py's families (both Python engines; 5,000 for two of them); arms A and A+ on the dev set before (c4d8d83) and after (6305217, recorded under protocol 2026-10-19.16), 2026-10-19
evidence: F1: the modulation null took an element's m sites as independent (P >= chi2_m / m at a zone-boundary point, chi2_2m / 2m at a general q). Sites that share a cell-level variable -- the six ligands of a Jahn-Teller octahedron sharing its long axis, the vertices of a cluster sharing its elongation or breathing -- make the Fourier amplitudes of one q correlated across sites, so the element's power has fewer independent components than m and a heavier tail than the null: the engine reported spurious order on 3 of 12 configurations of the two-feature judgment generator, 2 of 16 of dev-jahn-teller's and 1 of 10 octahedral ones. Measured before and after over 1,000 fresh configurations of each DEV generator kind (the dev parameters, new seeds that no case uses, JS engines; an order verdict is any element's cellDoubling or generalOrder, and after also diffuseOrder; Clopper-Pearson 95 % intervals): thermal_null 0/1000 (0.00 %, [0.00, 0.37]) -> 2/1000 (0.20 %, [0.02, 0.72]); offcentre 0 -> 1/1000 (0.10 %, [0.00, 0.56]); jahn_teller 88/1000 (8.80 %, [7.12, 10.73]) -> 1/1000 (0.10 %, [0.00, 0.56]); jahn_teller with offCentre (the two-feature kind) 121/1000 (12.10 %, [10.14, 14.28]) -> 2/1000 (0.20 %, [0.02, 0.72]); elongated_clusters 318/1000 (31.80 %, [28.92, 34.79]) -> 6/1000 (0.60 %, [0.22, 1.30]); breathing 1 -> 1/1000 (0.10 %); rigid_dimer 0 -> 2/1000 (0.20 %, [0.02, 0.72]). After, each configuration has three tests at the one-sided 3 sigma level (alpha = 0.135 % each, about 0.40 % for any of them). The same over tests/modulation_configs.py's families (1,000 configurations each, Python engines): thermal 0 -> 2, Jahn-Teller 94 (9.40 %, [7.66, 11.38]) -> 1, two-feature 110 (11.00 %, [9.13, 13.11]) -> 1, octahedral 298 (29.80 %, [26.98, 32.74]) -> 5 (0.50 %, [0.16, 1.16]), breathing 2 -> 2, rigid dimers 0 -> 1. Per test at 3 sigma, pooled over the six families (6,000 configurations): zone boundary 8 (0.13 %, [0.06, 0.26]), general modes 2 (0.03 %, [0.00, 0.12]), diffuse 2 (0.03 %, [0.00, 0.12]); on 5,000 octahedral configurations 6, 7 and 6 against 6.7 expected for each (0.12-0.14 %, every interval holding 0.135 %). The looser levels are calibrated too: at 2 sigma 13-26 configurations of 1,000 per family against 22.8 expected (zone boundary), at 1 sigma 134-171 against 158.7. The null before F1 was also conservative for independent sites: one isotropic site has three components, the bound took one; thermal configurations never reached 1 sigma. The fix: the null is the configuration's own cells placed at random, which keeps every correlation inside a cell and destroys every correlation between cells. Its cross-spectral matrix is white, E[U(q) U(q)^H] = N/(N - 1) sum_c y(c) y(c)^T at every q != 0, exactly the Parseval average of U U^H over q != 0 (no estimation beyond the configuration's own cells), so the element's power is a weighted sum of chi2_1 (zone boundary, a real Fourier sum) or of chi2_2/2 (general q) whose weights are that matrix's eigenvalues normalised as the power. A three-moment gamma (as orientation.py's map test) fell to 0.36-0.64 of the exact tail at 1e-4 to 1e-6 for one dominant weight over several small ones, and was anti-conservative on the breathing family's general modes (74 against 45.6 expected at 2 sigma over 2,000 configurations); the Lugannani-Rice saddlepoint lies 0 to +8 % above the exact tail (a Moschopoulos series) from 1e-2 to 1e-9 on every weight pattern checked: conservative (3 % below it at 1e-1, where no decision lies). Known answers: a Jahn-Teller F mode 5.35 times the median (3.66 sigma before, 1.42 after) and an octahedral W mode 6.04 times (4.46 -> 1.54), nothing ordered after; independent isotropic sites carry three components each, the six F of a Jahn-Teller octahedron about three in all; the null's weights sum to the mean power N/(N - 1); equal weights are the exact gamma (the old anchors hold). Power: the weak zone-boundary order of the judgment kind (B +-0.018 A, one isotropic site) is found in 441 of 1,000 configurations before (44.10 %, [40.99, 47.24]) and 992/1000 after (99.20 %, [98.43, 99.65]); dev-weak-order-a reads 6.41 sigma (was 3-4), dev-weak-order-b 5.65 sigma (was 2.96, below the bar), so the dev pair no longer straddles the 3 sigma bar; dev-zone-boundary's planted order and every other planted mode is still found; no dev case reads order it does not have. F3's known answer moves to a new weak doubling at the bar (Nb +-0.02 A: 2.99 sigma over the 21 points, 3.31 over Nb's 7). Arms A and A+ on dev before and after: every arm A and D record and every score is identical but one A+ record: dev-weak-order-b__A+ now claims the Nb modulation at (1/2, 1/2, 0) and scores 1 (was 0.8333), re-recorded in arm-a-dev.json under protocol 2026-10-19.16. The test set was not run. Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19.
proposed_fix: Both modulation engines (rmc_toolkits/modulations.py independent_cell_null, null_tail, zone_boundary_sigma, general_mode_sigma; workers/modulations.js independentCellNull, nullTail, zoneBoundarySigma, generalModeSigma, a cyclic Jacobi eigensolver for the null's weights): every zone-boundary point and general mode is tested against the independent-cell null of its element -- the eigenvalues of W^1/2 (N/(N - 1) sum_c y(c) y(c)^T) W^1/2, W = diag(1 / (m n_s tr C_s)), weights below 1e-12 of the largest left out -- with the exact gamma when the weights are equal (NULL_EQUAL_RTOL = 1e-12; an int m stands for m equal weights 1/m, the bound used until F1) and the Lugannani-Rice saddlepoint otherwise (bisection over SADDLEPOINT_STEPS = 200, its limit within SADDLEPOINT_W_MIN = 1e-6 of the mean). The ratio bar (3), the 3 sigma bar, the Sidak family (F3) and the general-mode rule are unchanged; each element reports nullDof = (sum lambda)^2 / sum lambda^2. The parity fixture is regenerated (a Jahn-Teller case and F3's new known answer added; the generator refuses near-equal weights at the tolerance), tests/test_modulation_calibration.py checks the false-positive rate (a fast subset of 15 configurations per family in CI; RMC_TOOLKITS_FULL_CALIBRATION=1 runs 1,000 configurations per family and checks each test at 3, 2 and 1 sigma against the binomial 99.9 % quantile), and tests/test_modulations.py NullTests pins the known answers. analyze_modulations reads its sigma 'against independent cells (each cell's own correlations kept)', and a nearest miss at sigma = -inf reads '< -8 sigma' (it printed 'nullsigma', which the calibrated null first reaches on the Demo's Ta). Protocol 2026-10-19.16. Commits 82801fe (engines) and 6305217 (tool, arms, protocol). The marginal judgment situation needs its amplitude re-set from the calibrated null (dev and held-out cases alike): the user's call. Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19.
